title: slo-toolkit: add autodiagnostics helper utilities and runbook linking improvements
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: On-call engineers rely on incident-bot + slo-toolkit to surface targeted diagnostics and runbook links during SLO alerts. This PR adds a set of helper utilities to the slo-toolkit that improve runbook autodiagnostics scoring and make runbook linking more robust for partial SLO matches. Changes: 1) new helpers/query modules: runbook_score.py and match_utils.py which encapsulate scoring heuristics and fuzzy matching thresholds; 2) expose a high-level API (slo_toolkit.autodiag.get_runbook_suggestions) used by incident-bot handlers; 3) add adaptive weighting to prefer runbooks with remediation actions when the on-call escalation level is critical; 4) safer fallbacks when runbook metadata is incomplete (owner/contact/last_updated); 5) add unit tests and integration harness for incident-bot to validate suggestions against a canonical SLO dataset; 6) update incident-bot handler to call the new API and include suggestion confidence in the on-call message payload. Testing: unit tests added (pytest) covering scoring heuristics and edge cases, integration test running incident-bot suggestion flow against seeded runbooks, manual verification in staging with a synthetic SLO alert. Rollout & safety: feature is behind feature-flag slo_autodiag_v2 and defaults to off; gradual rollout plan: 10% of alerts for 48h -> 50% for 72h -> full, with telemetry to monitor suggestion precision/recall. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration test harness [x] docs updated (internal runbook linking guide) [x] feature flagged [x] performance baseline measured.
